title: Your Path Into the Academy
description: No tests to pass online. Tell us about yourself, and our team will guide you personally to the right modules and sector pathway.

steps.title: Submit an Inquiry
steps.desc: Fill in the short form below with your details, experience and the sector you're interested in.

steps.title: Our Team Contacts You
steps.desc: An SLEDMC advisor will call or WhatsApp you within 2 working days to discuss your goals.

steps.title: Interview & Skills Review
steps.desc: A friendly in-person or online interview to understand your experience, language level and documents.

steps.title: Your Personal Module Plan
steps.desc: We recommend which of the 8 core modules and which sector pathway to follow — then you enrol and begin training.

form.title: Start Your Inquiry
form.description: It takes less than 2 minutes. There is no fee to submit an inquiry.

success.title: Bohoma Isthuthi — Thank You!
success.message: Your inquiry has been received. Our team will contact you within 2 working days to arrange your interview.
